name: What are the common mistakes homeowners make when caulking siding?

mainEntity.name: What are the common mistakes homeowners make when caulking siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes homeowners make when caulking siding include failing to properly prepare the surface by not removing old caulk or cleaning the area, leading to poor adhesion. Applying too much caulk or an uneven bead can create a messy appearance and an ineffective seal. Not using the correct type of caulk for the application or environmental conditions is another pitfall, as is attempting to caulk in extreme temperatures or wet weather. Rushing the process and not allowing sufficient curing time are also frequent errors that compromise the caulk's performance and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include improper surface prep, applying too much or uneven caulk, using the wrong caulk type, and not allowing sufficient curing time.
